issues.description: SAS has no included LIBNAME/root setup for ellipsis-rooted raw inputs and many pre-existing source tables. Their source mappings and working roots remain unestablished, so dependency closure is incomplete. The same-name generated county weather/control handoffs are covered separately as preparation and do not by themselves require author confirmation.
The trace leaves lib.year and working-directory/library resolution unresolved. Identify the author setup; do not guess a replacement table or assume same-basename paths coincide.

SAS writes county_weather_ann under lib at line 1643 and later reads the same-name table under air at line 1650; it creates lib.county_control at lines 171–172 and later reads mylocal.county_control at line 2557. These are same-data producer/consumer handoffs. Use a shared-root alias or copy configuration as preparation; different libref names alone do not imply a separate scientific source. Future schema, field, county/year-key and coverage validation remains.
The SAS driver includes winsorize.sas at main and Superfund branches, but the include is absent; its body/percentile behavior cannot be inferred from call sites.
SAS constructs lib.pew but does not export pew.dta; Stata Table 10 Panel B reads pew.dta.
SAS exports cces.dta lowercase, while Stata requests CCES.dta uppercase; this can fail on a case-sensitive filesystem.
The author county_fips lookup and separate lib.sic contract are unestablished. The Funda request explicitly omitted sic; that does not prove the underlying file lacks the field.

The firm panel begins in 1993 and uses one-year GDP growth; the cited official county GDP product begins in 2001. The regression step does not prove every county has usable 1993–2000 GDP observations.
Code expects prepared lib.inst_sum_07312019 with INSTOWN_PERC. Local TFN.S34 has raw fields and its bounded probe timed out; neither proves the prepared table or an equivalent transformation.

dependency_review.description: The same-name weather and county_control producers precede their consumers under different SAS library references. Treat these as generated same-data handoffs with shared-root alias/copy setup; retain future schema/key/coverage validation.
The required winsorize include is missing; it is invoked to produce lib.main, which the next SAS step exports.
SAS constructs lib.pew but does not export pew.dta; Stata Table 10 Panel B reads pew.dta.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for AGE_CENSUS_INPUT: Census age workbook builds child/senior county controls using age fields for 1990/2000/2010.

These frozen edges are raw inputs for ANES_SENSITIVE: Sensitive ANES survey/geocode input for Table 10 Panel C; selected waves 1990–2016 are named in code and exact wave/geocode mapping is unresolved.

These frozen edges are raw inputs for BEA_COUNTY_INPUT: BEA county GDP/population raw table feeds GDP imputation and one-year growth. Main panel begins in 1993 and requires a 1992 growth baseline; early GDP history unresolved.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for BRFSS_INPUT: County BRFSS CDBRFS01–10 and LLCP2011/2012 files feed county-year asthma measures. Exact year-specific fields and coverage unverified.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for CCES_COUNTY_FIPS_LOOKUP: Separate lib.county_fips lookup used to attach county identifiers to CCES records; no producer or exact source is supplied.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for CCES_INPUT: CCES year-specific files 2005–2018 in CSV/TAB/DTA/SAV formats; SAS uses varying mappings and county joins.

These frozen edges are raw inputs for CENSUS_COUNTY_RAW: Pre-existing county_raw used to construct demographic controls. Exact author file, columns and coverage are absent; code maps selected education values to 1990/2000/2010.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for CEO_BIRTHPLACE: CEO birthplace/identity input obtained from Shufang Lai; code joins by GVKEY, EXECID and year. Data dictionary/copy absent.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for CITY_COUNTY_LINK: City/county lookup used for weather and Compustat location assignment; author names Simplemaps, exact 2019 workbook is unverified.

These frozen edges are raw inputs for COMPUSTAT_FUNDA: Raw Compustat tax/financial fields. Local Funda probe reads 22 fields except sic, one row at 1961; no author table/history compatibility established.

These frozen edges are raw inputs for COMPUSTAT_SNAPSHOT: Compustat Snapshot firm/location input. WRDS is the author source; exact local candidate not verified; exact catalog miss does not prove absence.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for CORPORATE_CULTURE: Corporate-culture input obtained from Rui Shen; code joins by GVKEY/year. Data dictionary and compatible author copy are absent.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for COUNTY_CENTROID_INPUT: lib.countydistance_01252020 supplies county centroid coordinates for weather-station assignment; exact source/key/vintage unresolved.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for COUNTY_FINANCE_INPUT: County government expenditure input, joined by FIPS_Combined/Year4 and used in same/forward-year branches.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for EXECUCOMP_INPUT: ExecuComp manager-year data. Local EXECCOMP.ANNCOMP one-row probe reads expected fields; sample year 1992 is not a history check.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for FEC_INPUTS: FEC candidate, committee and itemized transaction files used for executive political matching across even election years 1980–2018.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for GOOGLE_TRENDS_INPUT: Google Trends workbook consumed to construct state-year air/ozone searches; exact query, export fields and required years unresolved.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for GVKEY_CIK_LINK: Separate WRDS GVKEY-to-CIK table used in penalty matching; link_05062021 library input is not supplied.

These frozen edges are raw inputs for INSTITUTIONAL_OWNERSHIP: Author lib.inst_sum_07312019 prepared ownership summary with INSTOWN_PERC and report dates. Local TFN.S34 is a raw candidate whose 15-second probe timed out, not a verified substitute.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for MSA_COUNTY_CROSSWALK: Census MSA/county geography crosswalk named by the SAS comment; no file is packaged and keys remain unverified.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for NOAA_HOURLY_INPUT: Hourly NOAA station CSVs 1990–2019; SAS reads station/date/hour and weather fields, applies filters and aggregates by station/year.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for NONATTAINMENT_INPUT: EPA county nonattainment raw history used in DiD branches; author table schema and year-field mapping unresolved.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for NPL_INPUT: EPA Superfund/NPL listing and deletion raw inputs for the Superfund DiD; exact site fields, completion dates and county match remain unverified.

These frozen edges are raw inputs for OZONE_PANEL: Author-supplied annual county ozone CSVs; code derives Ozone_8hour and joins county/year at t, t−1, t+1. All 29 annual files have bounded one-row header probes; no population/coverage claim.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for PERMNO_CUSIP_LINK: Separate WRDS PERMNO-to-CUSIP crosswalk used before ownership matching; date and history contract absent.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for PEW_WAVE33: Pew American Trends Panel Wave 33 input used to construct lib.pew; raw survey input is not in archive.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for QCEW_INPUT: BLS annual county employment workbooks allhlcn90–allhlcn20; code selects county/nonfarm rows and uses area/year/annual average employment.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for RELIGION_INPUT: County religion workbooks for 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010, combined by county/year. Exact historical fields and denominators unverified.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for RESPONSE_RATE_INPUT: Separate 1990 state response-rate lookup joined into social-capital construction.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for SASHELP_ZIPCODE: SASHELP.ZIPCODE ZIP-to-MSA lookup required by political and manager matching; no table probe performed.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for SIC_CLASSIFICATION_INPUT: Separate lib.sic table provides SIC/SIC2/SIC3 by GVKEY/fiscal year. Physical source and exact field contract remain unresolved.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for SOCIAL_CAPITAL_INPUT: NERCRD county social-capital data used for 1990/1997/2005/2009/2014; exact library schemas remain unknown.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for STATUTORY_TAX_INPUT: State-year statutory tax-rate table from author-named CSG Knowledge Center; exact product, dates and rate conventions unverified.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for TTI_TRAFFIC_INPUT: Texas A&M TTI 2019 urban mobility workbook used to construct county traffic exposure.

These frozen edges are raw inputs for VIOLATION_TRACKER_INPUT: Good Jobs First basic and parent workbooks feed penalties. Bulk spreadsheet delivery has a subscription condition; this does not bar all permitted routes.
These frozen edges are raw inputs for WEATHER_STATION_LOOKUP: Separate station information CSV supplies station coordinates and identifiers for county proximity matching.
The FEC and executive matching intermediates are produced by the cited SAS blocks in order; this does not verify execution.
ViolationTracker imports and transformations are generated from the two named workbook inputs.
County control output has a supplied SAS producer; its mylocal alias is reviewed separately.
Religion panel is produced from the required ARDA inputs.
Social-capital panel is produced from NERCRD and response-rate inputs.
Ozone intermediate is produced from the packaged annual files.
Weather intermediate is produced by the preceding station/county stage; its alias is reviewed separately.
Cash ETR table is produced from raw Compustat values using the confirmed forward join signs.
Google Trends state-year table is produced from the imported workbook.
MSA and state political preference tables are produced together from processed contribution data.
Civic factor table is produced from social-capital inputs.
Traffic table is produced from TTI data and Census geography mapping.
Penalty panel is produced from ViolationTracker basic/parent inputs.
Age-kid/old control table is produced from the Census age workbook.
Asthma panel is produced from year-specific BRFSS files.
QCEW table is produced by consolidating the annual BLS inputs.
BEA panel is produced from county_data after the supplied imputation/growth steps.
Prediction output is produced from the main panel stage.
Nonattainment, event-time, and prediction tables are produced in the cited ordered SAS stages.
CCES raw merged table is produced from year-specific source files.
CCES analysis table is produced from the source files and county lookup before its separately reviewed export.
Pew input is imported and transformed into lib.pew in memory; the missing persisted Stata handoff is a separate issue.
ANES county/year table is produced from the sensitive source input.
Superfund DiD table is produced from NPL and the main firm panel.
Each Stata handoff has a supplied SAS export statement in the cited source lines; execution remains unattempted.

review_notes: Static execution-feasibility assessment only. Neither author SAS or Stata programs, macros, models, estimators, regressions, nor datasets were executed/imported/compiled.

All 209 frozen dependency IDs are reviewed exactly once. Generated edges are credited only where a supplied producer appears in the ordered trace; unresolved raw inputs, author tables, aliases and missing producers remain explicit.
The 29 supplied annual ozone CSVs are the primary route and each has a bounded one-row probe. This verifies headers/readability only, not county population or annual coverage.
Ozone uses t−1/t/t+1. Separately, the cash ETR join uses Compustat t+1/t+2; main fiscal years 1993–2016 therefore require fundamentals through 2018. These windows are not interchangeable.

COMP.FUNDA and EXECCOMP.ANNCOMP are local candidates only. The Funda sic contract is unestablished; a COMP.SNAPSHOT catalog miss is not proof of absence; the TFN.S34 timeout is not proof of unavailability or lack of license.
The identifier XLSX is not a full analysis panel. Stata depends on SAS-produced inputs, so no analysis_only route is credited.

Tooling failures/corrections are recorded in probes/tool_error_log.json as process history, not as scientific or access evidence. Static public pages only were checked; no dataset payloads, API calls or external contacts were used.
